name: print-social-carousel-dark-mint-digital-tech-headline-tile
title: Dark and mint digital-technology carousel with bold headline lead tile
whatItIs: A companion grid from the same Digital Technology brand, reordering the lead tile to a bold 'DIGITAL TECHNOLOGY' dark headline card with a large outline gear icon and glow-dot accent.
whatItMeans: Swapping the grid's lead tile for a headline-forward cover shows an alternate first impression a brand can test, while every downstream tile stays visually identical to the sibling set.
techniques: use a giant single icon as the dominant graphic on a cover/title tile
add a small glowing dot accent to a flat icon to hint at 'active/on' status
keep a consistent grid density (mix of photo and icon tiles) across cover variants
bestFor: cover-tile A/B testing for template packs

vocabulary.definition: producing multiple lead/cover tile variants of the same content set to compare performance
